reviews.text: I had a vet recommended me to euthanized my guinea pig because I had questions about the quote. It's also a guinea pig that I bring there regularly, around every 2 months, because she has an on going problem. Good experience most of the time though.

I'm so lucky to have always received excellent care for my rabbits. The team's strength lies in their attentiveness, welcoming nature, and empathy! The quick access to care, the follow-up, and the advice help build a strong bond of trust. ♡

They also have a variety of toys and accessories to support local animal shelters.

I received a very warm welcome from Dr. Saulnier. I brought my two goldfinches and I really appreciated her approach. She knows birds very well, takes the time to examine them thoroughly, and, most importantly, explains everything simply.

I really liked her work ethic and her professionalism. You can tell she truly knows her stuff and takes her work to heart.

Well done, Dr. Saulnier, and thank you for your excellent work! I highly recommend her. 🐦👏

The service was incredible! The team was dedicated, kind, and attentive. My guinea pig needed urgent surgery, and the team helped us find a place for him quickly to receive treatment.

They were gentle with him, kept us updated on his condition, and provided excellent follow-up.

I found them very honest and transparent regarding their prices. Personally, I am extremely satisfied with all the care he received and the team's attentiveness.

This is an excellent place to entrust your pets to professionals. They reassured me and provided the best possible care for my pet.

Thank you so much.

Excellent, friendly service!
We called because our 5-month-old Conure started bleeding from one of its legs, and Rose, a technician, answered and helped us tremendously, all with a big smile (yes, I could hear it!) and a wonderful attitude.
She gave us lots of useful information.
Thank you so much, Rose; I don't know what we would have done without you!

my grey gets boarded here and seems happy whenever i pick him up. staff are kind.

there is one technician who comes off super condescending. I understand pellets are a priority but coming off condescending and rude in regards to my grey who has been fed seeds for 20 years before I adopted him - he is still being transitioned and its been a challenge. I shouldn't have to defend myself and feel put down when i'm just trying to drop him off for boarding.
He doesn't deal with exotic animals.

Completely satisfied with this veterinarian. After calling several exotic animal vets in the area for my three rats, this one is definitely one of the least expensive. The service is excellent and the staff is very kind! I highly recommend them!

Friendly welcome, although the wait in the waiting room was a bit long.
The vet was kind, attentive, and gave good advice.

I had a fantastic experience here. I had an emergency appointment for my pigeon because she was acting strange, I was able to get an appointment on the same day. The staff was very friendly, kind and knowledgeable. An exam, a bacterial test and 2 weeks of antibiotics only came back to 290$, which I was pleasantly surprised about!

I took an appointment for my bearded dragon.
The vet found out that she had a 2cm mass in her belly and that she was dying.
I’ve decided to let her go and stop all of her suffering.
The team was super kind and attentive to our needs.
She passed in the hands of good and professional people. I would recommend this place to anyone.
Really professional and kind.
Thank you so much again.
And hopefully patate ( my dragon ) lives in our heart forever. 🤍

My mother, my sister, Sam (our dove), and I received a wonderful welcome. The vet we saw was incredibly kind, explained things clearly, and was very gentle with our bird. Unfortunately, we didn't get a good diagnosis, and we had to make the difficult decision to let Sam go 🕊️. We had adopted him nine years ago, and he lived a very happy life until he became terribly ill. It was obviously not an easy decision, but we were very well supported, without judgment, and given all the time we needed to say a final goodbye, peacefully. Thank you so much!
The staff is great, compassionate and knowledgeable. My rats receive super great care and their advice is terrific. Can't recommend this hospital enough
Excellent service and very good animal care.

A huge thank you to the HVOE team for quickly and successfully removing our guinea pig's ovarian cysts.

The entire process went smoothly, and the team made sure we felt reassured every step of the way. The level of care was exceptional, and the price was more than fair.

Two weeks after the surgery, our guinea pig is doing great. She's gained weight, is much more active, and seems much happier. We couldn't be more grateful for the excellent care she received. Highly recommended!

I drive from 100km away, 1.5 hours away from Ontario, to get to this clinic. I have tried closer clinics but none have compared to the service and skills that this clinic provides. I've been going for 5 years now with 3 different rabbits. And all my future rabbits as well. Thank you for your amazing care of our babies 🐰❤️ Love from Opal and Puck

Brought my 10 year old bunny boomie here after moving to mtl. He got a dental trimming and an overall wellness exam. The vet took her time to explain all of his conditions and I left with a fantastic care plan.

A huge bonus is that they have very reasonable prices for an exotics specialist.

I would definitely recommend this place to anybody with a rabbit in the Montreal area :)
Phone number or email not working.

The best exotic animal hospital I've ever had the pleasure of visiting. A huge thank you to all the staff. From the receptionists and animal health technicians to the veterinarians, they are all incredibly warm, caring, and professional. You can tell that the health and well-being of our animals are their top priority, and this is evident in the quality of care and service provided. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone who wants the very best for their pets. 🐾🤍
Good service, affordable prices, and very humane treatment for our pets.

Unfortunately, we recently had to say goodbye to our beloved guinea pig, Oreo. The staff and doctors were incredibly kind, supportive, and caring throughout the entire process. They always tried their best to help with appointments and emergencies, and we truly appreciated all the care they gave to Oreo. Thank you to the whole team for your compassion and support during such a difficult time.

The experience was sad because my cockatiel was sick and I had to euthanize her 😢 but the staff were professional. There aren't many more bird clinics around. But they allowed her to be seen despite it being Saturday and I didnt have an appointment. May she rest in peace 😔❤️ …
Good veterinarians for exotic animals

So happy i found this place, just adopted my baby boy a month ago and came here for a general check up and castration. They explained everything to detail . I was worried at first as a first time bun mom but everyone was really reassuring i want to say a huge thank you to all the staff. The team is super friendly and was always there to answer questions.
Great experience! They explained everything clearly, reassured me, and handled my bird with so much care. Awesome selection of bird food and toys too. I’ll definitely be coming back for pellets ❤️

A specialized hospital for exotic animals where animal welfare is a true priority. The team is professional, caring, and always generous with advice. Thank you for the excellent care our birds receive at every visit.

This is my second time going to this clinic, and they've saved a customer for life.
My rat was having trouble breathing, and I thought I was going to lose him on the way there. I arrived in a panic as soon as they opened to get him put on oxygen, and they took him in immediately, even though they could have refused since my appointment was at 10:50 or thereabouts. Maybe an hour later, I heard the receptionist on the phone. Someone was calling about the same thing as me; they needed their pet put on oxygen urgently. She refused, explaining that there was only one room available, and it was occupied. She referred him to the emergency room in Laval, proving that they don't just care about money, as some people claim. They could have easily taken the other animal and removed my rat without me even knowing. They are honest and conscientious, even if it's just a "rat." Following the examination, they allowed me to keep him on oxygen, at my request. Of course, there are associated costs, but in the end, the amount was much less expensive than I expected.

Also, the staff are very understanding. My rat is about two years old and extremely anxious in the car. They allowed me to renew the antibiotic after two weeks instead of bringing it back and causing him stress.
My first visit was for a similar problem with another rat already known to have lung issues, and they allowed me to renew the prescription then. Finally, after four weeks, he was completely cured.
They take the time to answer our questions and address our concerns.

Furthermore, they took the time to call and check on my little Squeaky. I highly recommend them 100%, and a big thank you to the whole team. It's truly beautiful to see how much they care about us, beings so precious to us and who might be perceived as inferior by some. Squeaky is my first rat, my child, my love, and I feel 100% confident leaving him in the team's hands.
I've been bringing my rats to this vet for years, ever since I came back to Montréal. Their vets are fantastic. Could not praise them enough. Great work!

Thank you, thank you, thank you!! ❤️
Amazing team!
The receptionists were incredibly kind, even though I changed my appointment dates and times four times in one day.
The person who took care of my baby was so gentle and kind.

It was my first visit, and of course I hope it's my last, but if Onyx ever needs any further care, I'll definitely entrust him to you again!
Thank you so much for reassuring me; Onyx and I will sleep much better tonight! ❤️ Plus, the prices are more than reasonable!

Happy holidays to you all! From Onyx and me! ❤️
Wow, what a great experience!! The staff are lovely and very professional, I highly recommend them!! 🫶 …
Good and welcoming service

Professional, caring, and excellent with birds

I had a great experience at Hôpital vétérinaire pour oiseaux et animaux exotiques de Montréal inc. (6090 Sherbrooke St W, Montréal).

They helped me professionally with a problem my bird had, and honestly everything was handled really well. The staff were kind and respectful, the veterinarian was knowledgeable, and they took the time to explain things clearly so I felt reassured. You can tell they truly understand birds and exotic animals and take their work seriously.

I’m very grateful for the care they provided, and I would absolutely recommend them to anyone who wants trustworthy, professional help for their bird. 🐦💛

Great staff, very friendly and knowledgeable. They saved my bunny !
All staff are  fully bilingual

I unfortunately had to put down my very old and sick mouse, and the staff was so kind and gentle. Even though she was just a little mouse, they were very considerate. They gave the same weight to the process as you would expect them to do for a dog or cat. I really appreciated it.

We recently adopted some birds and I needed some advice. A kind, patient, and professional veterinarian took the time to listen to me and give me information over the phone. Her advice was very helpful, and I didn't have to make an appointment as I had thought.
The receptionist also gave me good information about the wait times for an appointment (which are quick) and the options for emergency clinics if needed.
In short, attentive and impeccable service!
I have been there on 2 seperate occassions and each visit was fantastic.  I am an owner of a 10 year old Quaker parrot.

My rabbit and I had a wonderful experience at the clinic for his checkup and vaccination. The staff were competent, courteous, and welcoming, and everything was explained to us in detail. His neutering also went very well; he was treated like the king he is.

A terrible experience.
3 hours of waiting, with absolutely no attention. They just put my bird in a tub and that was it. The vet told me they were extremely busy.

Then he died.
I should have given him vitamins; it would have saved me the €300 consultation fee.
Professionalism with heart. Merci!
Great staff, very thorough and took time to explain our options and made us feel equally comfortable picking either.
The animals are lucky! I highly recommend it.
Excellent service here! I recommend
Wonderful service!
My two rabbits are being treated there for dental problems. I am very satisfied.
Superb veterinarians, helpful with advice and caring.
I take my rabbits to this clinic and I'm very happy with their service. They're very kind, explain the options clearly, and I'm extremely grateful that the prices are quite reasonable! 😇 …

I had a great experience; everyone was incredibly respectful and honest. I was able to get an appointment the same day. They gave me a price estimate and several options, which I really appreciated. The vet and the technician treated my conure very well and gave me lots of helpful advice. 100% recommended.
Very kind staff, and I find it easy to get appointments that fit my schedule. They also give clear advice that helps me feel confident in how to care of my rabbits.

I want to thank the team for the exceptionally kind, compassionate and considerate service I got yesterday. I can't speak highly enough of everyone that I encountered when I brought my rabbit in after she had stopped eating and using the litter. I had been beside myself with worry when I called the clinic looking for advice. The whole team went out of their way to accommodate my situation. I deeply appreciate my interaction with them and would absolutely trust them to care for my beloved bunny again.
My rabbits have been boarded there twice during the holidays, and I left with complete confidence. I've been a client for several years and I'm very satisfied with this clinic.
Friendly and knowledgeable staff, our bird was taken care of fast. Parking is a bit difficult and prices are too high.

Well... to begin with, I called three days in advance to make an appointment, and one of the three to five receptionists told me it would be 12:30. I had to take time off work to go to the vets, and when I arrived, they told me there was no appointment under my name, even though I had proof of my call to the clinic. In any case, the clinic has terrible scheduling, and my exotic pet didn't receive any treatment. We were promised a simple consultation in 10-15 minutes, and later, they confirmed that it was no longer possible. A waste of time and no respect for the customer. 😔
Very disappointed with time ménagement

Nice clinc, very clean ,vet seemed to be very nice,and  she took her time with me. Answered all my questions..and the price was much more reasonable, then other places we've been to..they did mixed up our bill,  My hubby didn't even catch it.. they noticed as we were driving away they called us  asking  us to come back so they could fix it.
That is Class!!!
Nibbles -Mom ( Linstead)
No complaints. The examination was fast and the staff was professional. They took time to respond to all my questions.

The staff and the doctors are very polite and they try to help with appointments and any emergencies that may arise.
My guinea pigs were well taken care of.
During a very unfortunate emergency they referred me to the  emergency vet clinic in Laval and transferred our file there. Upon arrival it made it easier and less stressful to deal with. Unfortunately there was not very much that could be done.
I would like to sincerely thank all the staff that have seen my Theo and given him all the quality of life that was possible.
Very welcoming, the vets are very professional and gentle with the animals, they give very good explanations, very satisfied 😊 The only slightly complicated point is the parking …
Excellent veterinary clinic!
Great vet for rabbits
Always friendly and available for our fur and feather companions

I highly recommend this clinic. I now live in Trois-Rivières, but I still make the trip to go there. I always receive excellent service and advice for my ferrets. The veterinarians and technicians are kind and very compassionate, always caring, and do their best to help my animals (I have five ferrets). They are very attentive to the needs of their clients and their little patients. They always have availability (within a week). I recommend them a thousand times over!
I recently brought my pet bird in to be seen by a vet. The staff were very friendly and helpful, and the overall service was excellent.
Friendly staff, took great care of my conure. Instead of just saying "give her more veggies" and leaving the rest to me, they actually gave recommendations on how to get started on that.

**Honest Review: Disappointing Experience**
Rip 🪦 my bro 🥲
I want to share my recent experience with a cockatiel we received as a gift. Unfortunately, within just a few days, the bird developed a serious infection that required immediate veterinary attention. Time was of the essence, and I called the avian veterinary hospital to explain our situation. I made it clear that our cockatiel was in critical condition and needed urgent treatment to survive.

Regrettably, the employee informed me that the clinic was fully booked and that the earliest appointment available was the next day. I understand that they were busy, but it was incredibly frustrating to hear that they couldn't accommodate our urgent situation. The life of our beloved bird was at stake, and waiting another day was simply not an option.

The following evening, we checked on our cockatiel, only to find that he had passed away. The infection had worsened, and he lost too much blood. This heartbreaking outcome could have been avoided if the clinic had prioritized urgent cases like ours.

I believe the veterinary hospital needs to reassess their scheduling practices for emergencies involving birds. Our cockatiel was not just a pet; he was a living being with feelings and emotions. Birds, including cockatiels, deserve the same level of care and urgency that any other pet receives.

After informing the clinic of our loss, they offered a $50 refund and expressed their condolences. While I appreciate the gesture, it doesn’t change the fact that our bird suffered due to a lack of timely intervention.

I know that many others may have faced similar situations, and it’s crucial for veterinary practices to recognize the urgency of medical issues in animals. Pets like our cockatiel are not disposable; they are family members deserving of compassion and prompt care. Free HIM
All the staff here have been very kind with me and my rats.
I received excellent service. The staff are friendly and competent!

I took my 30-year-old cockatiel to this veterinary hospital! I'm writing this review because I absolutely loved Dr. Eugenie's approach! She's incredibly kind and attentive to our pet. ☺️ She explains what she's doing and discusses the treatment plan with us, making sure we understand everything. You can tell she has a wealth of knowledge in her field! Ultimately, she offers the best solutions (tests, treatments) for our pet's specific situation (she doesn't suggest unnecessary tests/treatments for $$$). Thank you, Eugenie!

Plus, there's free parking across from the vet's office.

As always when it comes to veterinary medicine, I will preface this review by saying I am a certified animal health technician with many years experience, and I have owned exotic pets (specifically rats) since high school.
I have visited this veterinary clinic multiple times and find them to be a professional, knowledgeable, and friendly clinic. The waiting room up front is very nice with large windows looking onto the street, a section of toys & accessories for exotic animals, as well as small racks with beautiful handmade jewelry and keychains for sale (all proceeds go to help animals). I feel safe bringing my pets here, I know they will be properly examined and cared for. The veterinarian always has a discussion with me about the situation where we decide together the best plan of action. The technicians are great at explaining the at-home care instructions and how to administer medications (including tips & tricks for more difficult patients) which is super appreciated, even if I have worked in the profession, cause that shows me that they offer everyone the same level of care regardless of their experience with animals - so important! Yes, they are the only exotic animal veterinary clinic on the island (the only other option is at CVL in Laval, which is far and more expensive), but even if they weren't, I would still bring my pets there. They also have a bird clinic, which is super cool! They don't always have the bird out, but you can sometimes hear it talking in the back—so cute! Parking can be a bit difficult to find between the side streets and the paid parking on Sherbrooke, but I've always managed to find a spot relatively easily.
